pro_course_detail.title: Speaking and Preperation Class (adults and children)
pro_course_detail.description:
Become confident in English!
In this class, I will guide you through a conversation by using material to read and discuss. Or we can prepare for an interview or an exam. You will achieve the skills you need to speak fluently with other English speakers. This class is tailored to you, your level, background, interests, and culture.

I have helped my students with:
- preparing for interviews
- gaining the fluency to talk to colleagues/clients or neighbors/locals
- their studies and homework in English (review what you took in class with me)
- simply practicing their skills and catching any mistakes they might have

You are welcome to bring any article, YouTube video, book, or life story to the conversation. 

You may ask me to explain a word or grammar structure, and I’ll be sure to include it in our conversation.
If you would like, I can include a writing assignment for you to complete and send to me before our next lesson, and I will send the corrections to you before our next class.
* This class is open for adults of all levels, and for children with prior English education.

pro_course_detail.title: Reading Together (adults and children)
pro_course_detail.description:
* This class must be on Google Meets, Skype, or VooV if I am going to share my screen.

For this class, we can agree on a book or article to read together.
I will screen-share the pages, or we will both hold a physical copy of the book. We will take turns reading one page at a time. This way, you can passively learn sentence structure and vocabulary, and you will learn correct pronunciations through my corrections and by listening to me read.
Of course, we will discuss the book and ask each other questions :)
* For professional men, I will not turn my camera on. I will share my screen instead.
